in_marathi.name: Anukta
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anukta हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘anukta’, which means ‘unspoken’ or ‘unmentioned’. It is a name of great significance in Hindu culture, representing the power of words and the importance of communication.
